cues.en: If you've done machine learning optimization before, you might have noticed that I did not include a test set in the previous video.
cues.zh: 如果之前做過機器學習最佳化，可能注意到上一支影片沒有測試集。

cues.en: That is, I trained the model on the entire data set and didn't evaluate it using a separate test set.
cues.zh: 也就是用整份資料訓練，沒有用另一份獨立測試集評估。

cues.en: That means that the results might have been at least somewhat attributable to overfitting, which means
cues.zh: 結果可能至少有一部分來自過擬合，也就是

cues.en: the model might have been memorizing some aspects of the text rather than really learning generalizable statistical characteristics of written language.
cues.zh: 模型可能記住了文字的某些部分，而非真正學到能泛化的書面語言統計特性。

cues.en: On the other hand, that's not really something to be concerned about because the main focus was on setting up a gradient descent loop.
cues.zh: 不過當時重點是設定梯度下降迴圈，所以不太需要擔心。

cues.en: But on the other other hand, it really is appropriate to include a test set.
cues.zh: 但另一方面，加入測試集確實比較妥當。

cues.en: And so that's what you are going to do in this code challenge.
cues.zh: 這個程式挑戰就要做這件事。

cues.en: Fortunately adding a test set isn't difficult conceptually or mathematically.
cues.zh: 幸好，概念、數學上都不困難。

cues.en: It does require some extra code, but that's also not so difficult.
cues.zh: 需要多寫些程式，但也不難。

cues.en: But what is a train test split and why do we need it?
cues.zh: 什麼是訓練與測試切分？為什麼需要？

cues.en: The thing to realize about optimization is that models generally perform well on the data they're trained on.
cues.zh: 要理解，模型通常會在自己訓練過的資料上表現良好。

cues.en: Not always, of course.
cues.zh: 當然，不是總如此。

cues.en: The model architecture, meta parameters, training, procedure, loss function, data set and so on all need to be appropriate and well constructed.
cues.zh: 模型架構、超參數、訓練流程、損失函數、資料集等等，都必須適當、設計良好。

cues.en: But the point is that it's relatively easy to get models to do well on the data they're trained on,
cues.zh: 但重點是，讓模型在訓練資料上做好，相對容易，

cues.en: in part because when a model sees a data set multiple times, it can start memorizing the data.
cues.zh: 部分原因是反覆看相同資料時，模型會開始記憶。

cues.en: For example, just memorizing a sequence of tokens in a text.
cues.zh: 例如直接記住文字的詞元序列。

cues.en: So then the idea is to evaluate model performance using a separate chunk of data that is similar to
cues.zh: 所以概念是，拿一份和訓練集相似，

cues.en: the training set, but that the model has not actually been trained on.
cues.zh: 但模型實際沒訓練過的獨立資料，評估表現。

cues.en: So the model also doesn't learn from the test data, meaning that you need to switch off gradient descent in the training loop.
cues.zh: 模型也不從測試資料學習，所以訓練迴圈裡，要對這部分關閉梯度下降。

cues.en: Uh oh, and by the way, in the machine learning literature, there's also a distinction between a dev set or development set and a test set.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，機器學習文獻也區分 dev set，開發集，以及測試集。

cues.en: But I'm not going to get into that distinction here.
cues.zh: 這裡不深入。

cues.en: Anyway, overfitting is actually less of an issue for llms compared to other deep learning models.
cues.zh: 總之，相較其他深度學習模型，LLM 的過擬合問題較小。

cues.en: This is partly because the training sets are absolutely galactically huge, which means that there's
cues.zh: 部分因為訓練集大得像宇宙，

cues.en: already so much variability in the training set to ensure generalization.
cues.zh: 已經有大量變異，有助確保泛化。

cues.en: And it also means that the models see the data set only a few times.
cues.zh: 也代表模型只會看資料集幾次。

cues.en: So if you have experience with other deep learning models, for example in computational vision.
cues.zh: 如果做過其他深度學習，例如電腦視覺，

cues.en: Then you probably have used many thousands of training epochs.
cues.zh: 可能用過幾千個訓練週期。

cues.en: Well, llms are often trained on only a few epochs, like maybe 4 or 5 epochs.
cues.zh: LLM 常只訓練幾個週期，例如四、五個。

cues.en: That seems like a tiny number, but each epoch is a gigantic amount of text.
cues.zh: 聽起來很少，但每個週期都有極大量文字。

cues.en: Anyway, that all just means that there isn't really much repetition when training, which means the model just doesn't have as much opportunity to memorize and overfit.
cues.zh: 所以訓練中沒有太多重複，模型就比較沒機會記憶、過擬合。

cues.en: So how does a train test split work?
cues.zh: 訓練與測試切分怎麼做？

cues.en: Imagine this blue bar here represents all of your data.
cues.zh: 想像藍色長條是全部資料。

cues.en: In our case, we're still working with the Time Machine book.
cues.zh: 這裡仍用《時間機器》。

cues.en: So imagine that this bar represents all 48,000 or whatever tokens in that book.
cues.zh: 想像長條代表書中大約 48,000 個詞元。

cues.en: So then you split the data into a segment of 90% of those tokens.
cues.zh: 把資料切成 90% 的一段。

cues.en: And you call that the training set?
cues.zh: 叫做訓練集。

cues.en: This is what you use to train the model.
cues.zh: 用來訓練模型。

cues.en: The loss function, the optimizer, and so on.
cues.zh: 使用損失函數、最佳化器等等。

cues.en: And the remaining 10% of the data you set aside.
cues.zh: 剩下 10% 留出來。

cues.en: And you call that the test set.
cues.zh: 叫做測試集。

cues.en: And that you use to evaluate the model after each epoch or maybe every few epochs.
cues.zh: 每個週期，或每隔幾個週期，用來評估。

cues.en: But you don't actually use this for training.
cues.zh: 但不真的用來訓練。

cues.en: So no gradients, no backprop, no optimizer.
cues.zh: 沒有梯度、反向傳播、最佳化器更新。

cues.en: You do apply the loss function to these data because you want to measure the loss here on these data, but you don't use that loss for learning or optimization.
cues.zh: 仍要套用損失函數，測量測試資料損失，但不用它學習、最佳化。

cues.en: And by the way, I'm illustrating this here as if it's the first 90% and the last 10% for the test.
cues.zh: 這裡畫成前 90% 訓練、後 10% 測試。

cues.en: That can be acceptable if there are no systematic differences.
cues.zh: 沒有系統性差異時，可以接受。

cues.en: For example, if there's something different about the end of the data compared to the rest of the data.
cues.zh: 例如資料最後一段是否和其他部分不同。

cues.en: In practice, it is more common to randomly sample sequences and batches from around the entire data set, but whether that is strictly necessary depends on the data set.
cues.zh: 實務上更常從整份資料隨機抽取序列與批次，但是否嚴格必要，取決於資料集。
